chunks.topicKh: លេខកុំផ្លិច
chunks.text: សេចក្តី I a) គណនា A² ដែល A = (√3−1) + i(√3+1) ហើយបង្ហាញទម្រង់ត្រីកោណមាត្ររបស់ A²។
chunks.normalizedText: Complex number A = (√3-1) + i(√3+1): compute A² in algebraic form, then convert to trigonometric (polar) form. Result: A² = -4√3 + 4i = 8(cos(5π/6) + i·sin(5π/6)).

problem.textKh: ឱ្យ A = (√3−1) + i(√3+1)។ ក) សូរគណនា A² ជាទម្រង់ពិជគណិត ហើយបង្ហាញ A² ជាទម្រង់ត្រីកោណមាត្រ។
problem.text: Given A = (√3−1) + i(√3+1). Find A² in algebraic form and express A² in trigonometric form.

solutionSteps.textKh: គណនា A² ដោយអនុវត្តរូបមន្ត (a+b)²

solutionSteps.text: Compute each term: (√3−1)² = 4−2√3; i²(√3+1)² = −(4+2√3); cross term = 2(3−1)i = 4i

solutionSteps.textKh: ចម្លើយទម្រង់ពិជគណិត

solutionSteps.text: Find argument: cos θ = -√3/2, sin θ = 1/2 → θ = 5π/6

solutionSteps.textKh: ទម្រង់ត្រីកោណមាត្រ

finalAnswer.textKh: ចម្លើយ: A² = −4√3 + 4i ហើយ A² = 8(cos(5π/6) + i·sin(5π/6))

chunks.text: I b) ឱ្យ B = (x+iy)/(1+i)។ សម្រួល B ជាទម្រង់ a+bi ហើយស្វែងរក x, y ពីលក្ខខណ្ឌ 2B̄ − A² = 0
chunks.normalizedText: Complex number B = (x+iy)/(1+i): simplify to algebraic form B = (x+y)/2 + (y-x)/2·i. Then use 2B̄ - A² = 0 with A² = -4√3 + 4i to get system: x+y = -4√3, x-y = 4. Solution: x = -2√3+2, y = -2√3-2.

problem.textKh: ឱ្យ B = (x+iy)/(1+i)។ ខ) សម្រួល B ជាទម្រង់ a+bi; ស្វែងរក x និង y ដែលបំពេញ 2B̄ − A² = 0 (B̄ ជាចំនួនបន្ថែមស្វ័យគុណរបស់ B)
problem.text: Given B = (x+iy)/(1+i). Simplify B to algebraic form, then find x and y such that 2B̄ − A² = 0.

solutionSteps.textKh: ធ្វើអតិភូតសំណាញ់
solutionSteps.text: Rationalize by multiplying numerator and denominator by conjugate (1-i)

អនុវត្តលក្ខខណ្ឌ 2B̄ − A² = 0
ប្រៀបធៀបផ្នែកពិត និងផ្នែកស្រមម

solutionSteps.text: Solve: adding gives x = -2√3+2; substituting back gives y = -2√3-2

chunks.topicKh: សមីការឌីផេរ៉ង់ស្យែល — ការបំបែកអថេរ
chunks.text: II) ដោះស្រាយសមីការឌីផេរ៉ង់ស្យែល (E): y′ − y·ln3 = 0; ស្វែងរកដំណោះស្រាយជាក់លាក់ f(1) = 2; បញ្ជាក់ g(x) = 3^(x-1) ជាដំណោះស្រាយ
chunks.normalizedText: ODE (E): y' - y·ln3 = 0. General solution by separation of variables: y = A·3^x, A ∈ ℝ. Particular solution with f(1)=2: f(x) = (2/3)·3^x = 2·3^(x-1). Verify g(x) = 3^(x-1) satisfies (E) using (aˣ)' = aˣ·ln a.

problem.textKh: II) ឱ្យមានសមីការ (E): y′ − y·ln3 = 0។ ក) រកដំណោះស្រាយទូទៅ; ខ) ស្វែងរក f ដំណោះស្រាយ f(1)=2; គ) បញ្ជាក់ g(x)=3^(x-1) ជាដំណោះស្រាយ (ដោយប្រើ U(x)=aˣ, U′(x)=aˣ·ln a)
problem.text: ODE (E): y' - y·ln3 = 0. a) Find general solution; b) Find particular solution with f(1)=2; c) Verify g(x)=3^(x-1) satisfies (E).

solutionSteps.textKh: ក) ការបំបែកអថេរ: dy/y = ln3·dx
solutionSteps.latex: \frac{dy}{y} = \ln 3\, dx \Rightarrow \ln|y| = x\ln 3 + C \Rightarrow y = \pm e^C \cdot e^{x\ln 3} = A\cdot 3^x,\ A\in\mathbb{R}

solutionSteps.text: c) Verify: g(x) = 3^(x-1), using (aˣ)′ = aˣ·ln a: g′(x) = 3^(x-1)·ln3

finalAnswer.text: a) y = A·3^x, A ∈ ℝ; b) f(x) = 2·3^(x-1); c) g(x) = 3^(x-1) satisfies (E)

formulas.meaning: Derivative of exponential function with base a

chunks.text: III ក) ស្វែងរក a, b, c ដើម្បីបំបែក (x²−2x−2)/((x−1)²(x+2)) = a/(x−1) + b/(x−1)² + c/(x+2)
chunks.normalizedText: Partial fraction decomposition: (x²-2x-2)/((x-1)²(x+2)) = a/(x-1) + b/(x-1)² + c/(x+2). Finding coefficients by expanding and comparing: a = 1/3, b = -1, c = 2/3.

problem.text: Find real numbers a, b, c such that (x²-2x-2)/((x-1)²(x+2)) = a/(x-1) + b/(x-1)² + c/(x+2).

solutionSteps.textKh: ធ្វើ numerator រួម: a(x-1)(x+2) + b(x+2) + c(x-1)² = x²−2x−2
solutionSteps.text: Multiply both sides by (x-1)²(x+2) and expand

solutionSteps.textKh: ប្រៀបធៀបមេគុណ x², x¹, x⁰

solutionSteps.text: Solve: from (1) a = 1-c; substitute into (2) b = 3c-3; substitute into (3) to get c = 2/3

chunks.subject: math
chunks.topicKh: ដែន​ — lim (eˣ ln x + 1)/x² ពេល x→+∞
chunks.text: IV ក) គណនាដែន lim_{x→+∞} (eˣ·ln(x)+1)/x², x > 0
chunks.normalizedText: Limit as x→+∞ of (e^x·ln(x)+1)/x². Since e^x grows faster than any polynomial, lim = +∞.

problem.textKh: គណនាដែន lim_{x→+∞} (eˣ·ln(x)+1)/x², x > 0

solutionSteps.textKh: ដោយ eˣ/x² → +∞ (eˣ ធំជាង polynomial ណាមួយ) ហើយ ln(x) → +∞ → ផ្នែកទីមួយ = +∞·(+∞) = +∞
solutionSteps.text: Since e^x/x² → +∞ (exponential dominates polynomial) and ln(x) → +∞, first term → +∞

finalAnswer.textKh: ចម្លើយ: ដែន = +∞

formulas.meaning: Exponential grows faster than any polynomial

chunks.subject: math
chunks.topicKh: អាំងតេក្រាលអំពីខ្លួន — y = eˣ·ln(x+1)
chunks.text: IV ខ) ស្វែងរក antiderivative F(x) របស់ f(x) = eˣ·ln(x+1) + (eˣ+1)/(x+1) ជាមួយ F(0)=1
chunks.normalizedText: Find antiderivative of f(x) = e^x·ln(x+1) + (e^x+1)/(x+1). Recognize that d/dx[e^x·ln(x+1)] = e^x·ln(x+1) + e^x/(x+1). So F(x) = e^x·ln(x+1) + ln|x+1| + C. With F(0)=1: C=1.

problem.textKh: IV ខ) ជំហ) ស្វែងរក antiderivative F(x) នៃ f(x) = eˣ·ln(x+1) + (eˣ+1)/(x+1) ដែល F(0)=1
problem.text: Find antiderivative F(x) of f(x) = e^x·ln(x+1) + (e^x+1)/(x+1) satisfying F(0)=1.

solutionSteps.textKh: ស្គាល់ derivative របស់ y = eˣ·ln(x+1): y′ = eˣ·ln(x+1) + eˣ/(x+1)
អាំងតេក្រាល: F(x) = eˣ·ln(x+1) + ln|x+1| + C
ប្រើលក្ខខណ្ឌ F(0)=1: e⁰·ln(1) + ln(1) + C = 1 → C = 1

finalAnswer.textKh: ចម្លើយ: F(x) = eˣ·ln(x+1) + ln|x+1| + 1, x > 0

formulas.meaning: Integration by parts grouping: d[e^x·ln(x+1)] = e^x·ln(x+1)dx + e^x/(x+1)dx

chunks.text: V ក) ស្វែងរកសមីការបន្ទាត់ D ដែលឆ្លងកាត់ S(0,0,3) ហើយស្របទិសជា u⃗ = (1,1,1)
chunks.normalizedText: Find equation of line D passing through S(0,0,3) with direction vector u⃗ = (1,1,1). Parametric equations: x=t, y=t, z=3+t, t∈ℝ.

problem.textKh: V ក) ក្នុងប្រព័ន្ធ (O, i⃗, j⃗, k⃗): S(0,0,3), u⃗=(1,1,1)។ ស្វែងរកសមីការបន្ទាត់ D ឆ្លងកាត់ S ស្របទិស u⃗
problem.text: In orthonormal frame (O, i⃗, j⃗, k⃗): S(0,0,3), u⃗=(1,1,1). Find equation of line D through S with direction u⃗.

solutionSteps.textKh: ប្រើរូបមន្តបន្ទាត់: x = x₀+at, y = y₀+bt, z = z₀+ct
solutionSteps.text: Apply parametric line formula with point S(0,0,3) and direction (1,1,1)
solutionSteps.latex: D:\begin{cases} x = 0 + 1\cdot t \\ y = 0 + 1\cdot t \\ z = 3 + 1\cdot t \end{cases},\quad t\in\mathbb{R}

finalAnswer.textKh: ចម្លើយ: D: x=t, y=t, z=3+t, t∈ℝ
finalAnswer.latex: D:\begin{cases} x = t \\ y = t \\ z = 3+t \end{cases},\quad t\in\mathbb{R}

formulas.latex: D:\begin{cases} x = x_0 + at \\ y = y_0 + bt \\ z = z_0 + ct \end{cases}
formulas.meaning: Parametric equations of a line through (x₀,y₀,z₀) with direction (a,b,c)

chunks.normalizedText: V b) Given M(x,y,z) in frame (O,i,j,k): compute dot product u⃗·SM⃗ = x+y+z-3. Condition SM⃗ ⊥ u⃗ means u⃗·SM⃗ = 0 → x+y+z-3=0. This is the plane through S perpendicular to u⃗; M lies on the intersection of D and this plane.

problem.textKh: V ខ) M(x,y,z) ចំណុចទូទៅ; S(0,0,3)។ គណនា u⃗·SM⃗; ស្វែងរក x,y,z ដែលបំពេញ SM⃗ ⊥ u⃗; M ណា?
problem.text: V b) M(x,y,z) general point; S(0,0,3). Find u⃗·SM⃗; find x,y,z with SM⃗ ⊥ u⃗; what is M?

solutionSteps.text: SM⃗ ⊥ u⃗ ↔ x+y+z-3=0. M on D: substitute t+t+(3+t)-3=0 → t=0 → M = S = (0,0,3)
solutionSteps.latex: x+y+z-3=0 \text{ and } M\in D \Rightarrow t=0 \Rightarrow M = S(0,0,3)

finalAnswer.textKh: ចម្លើយ: u⃗·SM⃗ = x+y+z−3; x,y,z ស្ថិតនៅ x+y+z−3=0; M = S(0,0,3)
finalAnswer.text: u⃗·SM⃗ = x+y+z-3; condition: x+y+z-3=0; intersection gives M = S(0,0,3)

chunks.text: V គ-ឃ) A(3,0,0), B(0,3,0), S(0,0,3): បញ្ជាក់ △SAB ជាត្រីកោណស្មើជ្រុង; គណនា SA⃗×SB⃗ និងផ្ទៃ △SAB
chunks.normalizedText: With A(3,0,0), B(0,3,0), S(0,0,3): SA=SB=AB=3√2 so △SAB is equilateral. Cross product SA⃗×SB⃗ = 9i⃗+9j⃗+9k⃗. Area = (1/2)|SA⃗×SB⃗| = 9√3/2.

problem.textKh: V គ) A(3,0,0), B(0,3,0), S(0,0,3)។ បញ្ជាក់ △SAB ជាត្រីកោណស្មើជ្រុង។ ឃ) គណនា SA⃗×SB⃗ ។
problem.text: Prove △SAB is equilateral. Then compute SA⃗×SB⃗.

solutionSteps.textKh: SA = SB = AB = 3√2 → △SAB ជាត្រីកោណស្មើជ្រុង
solutionSteps.latex: SA = SB = AB = 3\sqrt{2} \Rightarrow \triangle SAB\text{ is equilateral}

finalAnswer.textKh: ចម្លើយ: △SAB ជាត្រីកោណស្មើជ្រុង (SA=SB=AB=3√2); SA⃗×SB⃗ = 9i⃗+9j⃗+9k⃗; ផ្ទៃ = 9√3/2

chunks.subject: math
chunks.topicKh: ធរណីមាត្រក្នុងលំហ — សមីការស្វ៊ែរ ឆ្លងកាត់ O, S, A, B
chunks.normalizedText: Find sphere passing through O(0,0,0), S(0,0,3), A(3,0,0), B(0,3,0). Center must be equidistant from all four points. Since O is at origin, sphere equation x²+y²+z²=r². Distance from O to S: r = OS = 3. Sphere: x²+y²+z²=9.

problem.textKh: V ង) ស្វែងរកសមីការស្វ៊ែរ ឆ្លងកាត់ O, S, A, B
problem.text: Find the equation of the sphere passing through O(0,0,0), S(0,0,3), A(3,0,0), B(0,3,0).

solutionSteps.textKh: ទម្រង់ស្វ៊ែរ: (x−a)²+(y−b)²+(z−c)²=r²
O(0,0,0) ស្ថិតនៅលើស្វ៊ែរ → a²+b²+c²=r²
S(0,0,3): a²+b²+(c−3)²=r² → a²+b²+c²−6c+9=r² → 6c=9 → c=3/2... ប៉ុន្តែ O ស្ថិតនៅ center ហើយ r=OS=3
solutionSteps.text: Since O is the origin and |OS|=|OA|=|OB|=3, center is equidistant → sphere centered at (3/2,3/2,3/2) with r=3 passes through all. But checking: O on sphere → (x−3/2)²+...=r². Alternatively: sphere through O: x²+y²+z²=9 since OS=OA=OB=3

solutionSteps.textKh: ដោយ OS=OA=OB=3 ហើយ O ស្ថិតនៅ sphere ដែល center គ្រប់ point ឆ្ងាយ r=3 ពី center, sphere ឆ្លងកាត់ O: x²+y²+z²=9
solutionSteps.text: All four points satisfy x²+y²+z²=9 (each at distance 3 from origin). Sphere equation: x²+y²+z²=9.

finalAnswer.textKh: ចម្លើយ: សមីការស្វ៊ែរ x²+y²+z²=9

formulas.meaning: Standard equation of sphere with center (a,b,c) and radius r

chunks.normalizedText: Function f(x) = -x/2 + ln((x-1)/x) on D = (-∞,0)∪(1,+∞). Limits: as x→-∞: +∞; x→+∞: -∞; x→0⁻: +∞; x→1⁺: -∞. Vertical asymptotes at x=0 and x=1.

problem.textKh: VI ក) ជំហ) f(x) = −x/2 + ln((x-1)/x), D = (−∞,0)∪(1,+∞)។ គណនាដែន lim_{x→-∞}, lim_{x→+∞}, lim_{x→0⁻}, lim_{x→1⁺} f(x) ហើយស្វែងរកស្វ័យភាពស្ករ
problem.text: f(x) = -x/2 + ln((x-1)/x), D = (-∞,0)∪(1,+∞). Find limits as x→-∞, +∞, 0⁻, 1⁺ and identify asymptotes.

solutionSteps.textKh: ស្វ័យភាពស្ករ: x=0 និង x=1 (ដែនដែន ±∞ → ស្វ័យភាពស្ករ)
solutionSteps.text: Vertical asymptotes at x=0 and x=1

finalAnswer.textKh: ចម្លើយ: x=0 និង x=1 ជាស្វ័យភាពស្ករ
finalAnswer.text: x=0 and x=1 are vertical asymptotes

problem.textKh: VI ខ) ១) គណនា f′(x); ២) ចាត់ចែក f′(x)>0 ក្នុង D; ៣) ធ្វើតារាងប្រែប្រួល
problem.text: VI b) Compute f'(x); show f'(x) > 0 iff x(x-1) > 0; make variation table.

finalAnswer.text: f'(x) = (-x²+x+2)/(x(x-1)); local max at x=-1: f(-1)≈1.2; local min at x=2: f(2)≈-1.7

chunks.normalizedText: Show that y = -x/2 is an oblique asymptote to the curve C of f(x) = -x/2 + ln((x-1)/x). Key: f(x) - (-x/2) = ln((x-1)/x) = ln(1-1/x) → ln1 = 0 as x→±∞.

problem.textKh: VI គ) បង្ហាញ L: y = −x/2 ជាស្វ័យភាពទ្រេតនៃ C

solutionSteps.textKh: ដែន = 0 → L: y=−x/2 ជាស្វ័យភាពទ្រេតរបស់ C
solutionSteps.text: Since limit equals 0, y = -x/2 is an oblique asymptote

finalAnswer.textKh: ចម្លើយ: y = −x/2 ជាស្វ័យភាពទ្រេតរបស់ C
finalAnswer.text: y = -x/2 is an oblique asymptote of C
finalAnswer.latex: y = -\frac{x}{2}\text{ is an oblique asymptote of }C

chunks.topicKh: ចំនួន​ដំណោះ​ស្រាយ​នៃ​សមីការ​ f(x) = a
chunks.text: VI ឃ) ស្វែងរក a ដើម្បីឱ្យ −x/2 + ln((x−1)/x) = a មាន​ដំណោះ​ស្រាយ ​​ជាក់ exact ២
chunks.normalizedText: Find values of a such that f(x) = a (i.e., the horizontal line y=a intersects C exactly 2 times). From the graph and variation table: f has local max at f(-1)≈1.2 and local min at f(2)≈-1.7. The line y=a intersects C exactly 2 times when a ∈ (1.2, +∞). (Uses given values ln2=0.7, ln(1/2)=-ln2=-0.7.)

problem.textKh: VI ឃ) ស្វែងរក a ដើម្បីឱ្យ f(x) = a មានដំណោះស្រាយ​​ជាក់​ exact ២ (ប្រើ ln2=0.7, ln(1/2)=-0.7)
problem.text: Find a such that -x/2 + ln((x-1)/x) = a has exactly 2 solutions. Use ln2=0.7, ln(1/2)=-0.7.

solutionSteps.textKh: ប្រៀបតារាងប្រែប្រួល: C មានចំណុចទ្រូម (-1, 1.2) និង ចំណុចទ្រូធំ (2, -1.7)
solutionSteps.text: From variation table: C has local max at (-1, 1.2) and local min at (2, -1.7)

solutionSteps.textKh: គំនូស C ប្ប្រសព្វ y=a ជាក់ 2 ដង: x=a ត្រូវវាច x=-1 (ក្នុង branch (-∞,0)) ឬ x=2 (ក្នុង (1,+∞)) ​ → y=a > f(-1)=1.2 ​ ​ ​​​​
solutionSteps.text: For exactly 2 intersections, line y=a must be above the local max on the left branch: a > 1.2
